info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Carrental Reservations Returns-v2-spec
info.description: The Rental Reservation Returns Management API enables users to access details regarding car rental reservations that are marked for return. This endpoint allows business partners and fleet managers to efficiently track and manage the return status of vehicles. Use cases include verifying the return schedule, monitoring vehicle conditions at return, and assisting customers with their return queries. This API is particularly useful for car rental agencies and fleet management systems needing to streamline the vehicle return process.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of active reservations that are eligible for return. It includes details such as reservation ID, item information, and return deadline.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a return operation for reservations. It contains necessary parameters to identify the reservation and process the return effectively.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation related to reservation returns.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsResponse.title: Reservation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier of the result for the reservation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the reservation operation.

ListCarrentalReservationsReturnsResponse.description: Schema representing the response for a successful reservation retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the reservation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reservation was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the auditing information for the reservation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header allows clients to gauge the performance of the API call.
